texts: Nested shells of computronium around a star, each living on the waste heat of the one inside. It thinks; I gain Insight.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.

This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.$(br2)The idea is Robert Bradbury's, from 1997: a Dyson sphere turned into a computer, the largest mind a single star could power.
Every computation the brain finishes grants its owner $(thing)5 Insight$() - the brain does my science for me. I have started leaving it questions overnight.
The $(item)Neural Synthesizer$() grows photonic neural networks and the artificial minds that run on them.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Photonic networks compute with light instead of electrons: interference in waveguides performs the matrix multiplications at the heart of a neural network, fast and with little heat. I have stopped asking what the minds think of me.
The $(item)Psionic Resonator$() amplifies and crystallises thought itself.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
I must be honest in my own notebook: there is no known physics of psionics. Thought, as far as anyone knows, is electrochemistry in neurons. Yet the resonator works. I record; I do not yet explain.
